# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/actions/variables

Get an org-level variables list

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-043`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []ActionVariable

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `owner_id` | int64 | Owner ID of the variable |
| `repo_id` | int64 | Repo ID (0 for org-level) |
| `name` | string | Variable name (uppercased) |
| `data` | string | Variable value |
| `description` | string | Variable description |
